name: Company
overview: Scripture warns believers to be discerning about their company, emphasizing the danger of joining in with those who practice evil, as seen in the caution against following a multitude to do wrong or making covenants with ungodly inhabitants that can lead to sin and spiritual snare. The examples in Genesis and Exodus highlight the importance of avoiding secret assemblies and alliances that promote violence or idolatry, urging God’s people to separate themselves from influences that compromise their faith and obedience to God.
